measureName: Persistence of Beta-Blocker Treatment After a Heart Attack
description: Percentage of members 18 years and older hospitalized and discharged with Acute Myocardial Infarction (AMI) who received persistent beta-blocker treatment for 180 days after discharge.

denominator.eligiblePopulation: Members hospitalized and discharged with AMI between July 1 prior year and June 30 measurement year.

numerator.numeratorDefinition: Members who remained on beta-blocker therapy for 180 days after discharge.

measureName: Statin Therapy for Patients With Cardiovascular Disease
description: Percentage of members with clinical ASCVD who received statin therapy and remained adherent to therapy.

denominator.eligiblePopulation: Members diagnosed with ASCVD.

rates.name: Received Statin Therapy
rates.definition: At least one high or moderate intensity statin dispensed.

measureName: Cardiac Rehabilitation
description: Percentage of members attending cardiac rehabilitation after a qualifying cardiac event.

continuousEnrollment.enrollmentRule: Continuous enrollment after qualifying cardiac event

denominator.eligiblePopulation: Members with qualifying cardiac event.

measureName: Glycemic Status Assessment for Patients With Diabetes
description: Percentage of members 18-75 years of age with diabetes whose most recent glycemic status was assessed during the measurement year.

denominator.eligiblePopulation: Members age 18-75 with Type 1 or Type 2 Diabetes.

numerator.numeratorDefinition: Most recent HbA1c or GMI result recorded during the measurement year.

measureName: Blood Pressure Control for Patients With Diabetes
description: Percentage of members 18-75 years of age with diabetes whose blood pressure was adequately controlled during the measurement year.

denominator.eligiblePopulation: Members age 18-75 with Type 1 or Type 2 Diabetes.

numerator.numeratorDefinition: Most recent blood pressure reading is below 140/90 mmHg.

commonErrorsToAvoid: Using older BP reading instead of most recent reading

measureName: Eye Exam for Patients With Diabetes
description: Percentage of members 18-75 years of age with diabetes who received a retinal eye exam.

denominator.eligiblePopulation: Members age 18-75 with Type 1 or Type 2 Diabetes.

numerator.numeratorDefinition: Retinal eye exam performed during the measurement year.
numerator.complianceThresholds: At least one retinal eye examination.

commonErrorsToAvoid: Vision screening submitted instead of retinal exam

measureName: Kidney Health Evaluation for Patients With Diabetes
description: Percentage of members 18-85 years of age with Type 1 or Type 2 Diabetes who received both an eGFR and uACR during the measurement year.

denominator.eligiblePopulation: Members age 18-85 with Type 1 or Type 2 Diabetes.

numerator.numeratorDefinition: Member received BOTH eGFR and uACR during the measurement year.

measureName: Statin Therapy for Patients With Diabetes
description: Percentage of members 40-75 years of age with diabetes and without ASCVD who received and adhered to statin therapy.

denominator.eligiblePopulation: Members age 40-75 with diabetes and without ASCVD.

numerator.numeratorDefinition: Two rates reported: Received Statin Therapy and Statin Adherence 80%.

measureName: Osteoporosis Management in Women Who Had a Fracture
description: Percentage of women 67-85 years of age who suffered a fracture and received osteoporosis management within 180 days.

denominator.eligiblePopulation: Women 67-85 with a qualifying fracture.

numerator.numeratorDefinition: Bone Mineral Density test OR osteoporosis medication within 180 days after fracture.

measureName: Osteoporosis Screening in Older Women
description: Percentage of women 65-75 years of age who received osteoporosis screening.

denominator.eligiblePopulation: Women 65-75 years of age.

numerator.numeratorDefinition: At least one osteoporosis screening during the measurement period.

measureName: Diagnosed Mental Health Disorders
description: Percentage of members age 1 year and older diagnosed with a mental health disorder during the measurement year.

denominator.eligiblePopulation: Members age 1 year and older enrolled during the measurement year

numerator.numeratorDefinition: Member has at least one qualifying mental health diagnosis during the measurement year.
numerator.complianceThresholds: At least one mental health diagnosis.

measureName: Follow-Up After Hospitalization for Mental Illness
description: Percentage of discharges for members age 6 and older hospitalized for mental illness or intentional self-harm who received follow-up care.

continuousEnrollment.enrollmentRule: Continuous enrollment through 30 days after discharge

denominator.eligiblePopulation: Acute inpatient discharges with principal diagnosis of mental illness or intentional self-harm.

exclusions.description: Transfer to another acute inpatient facility.

measureName: Follow-Up After Emergency Department Visit for Mental Illness
description: Percentage of ED visits for members age 6 and older with mental illness or intentional self-harm diagnosis who received follow-up care.

continuousEnrollment.enrollmentRule: Continuous enrollment through 30 days after ED visit

denominator.eligiblePopulation: Emergency Department visits with principal diagnosis of mental illness or intentional self-harm.

measureName: Diagnosed Substance Use Disorders
description: Percentage of members age 13 years and older diagnosed with a substance use disorder during the measurement year.

denominator.eligiblePopulation: Members age 13 years and older enrolled during the measurement year.

numerator.numeratorDefinition: At least one qualifying substance use disorder diagnosis during the measurement year.

measureName: Follow-Up After High-Intensity Care for Substance Use Disorder
description: Percentage of acute inpatient hospitalizations, residential treatment or withdrawal management visits for substance use disorder that result in a follow-up visit.

continuousEnrollment.enrollmentRule: Continuous enrollment through 30 days post discharge

denominator.eligiblePopulation: Acute inpatient hospitalization, residential treatment or withdrawal management visit with SUD diagnosis.

measureName: Follow-Up After Emergency Department Visit for Substance Use
description: Percentage of ED visits for substance use disorder or drug overdose followed by SUD treatment services.

continuousEnrollment.enrollmentRule: Continuous enrollment through 30 days after ED visit

denominator.eligiblePopulation: ED visit with principal SUD diagnosis or drug overdose diagnosis.

measureName: Pharmacotherapy for Opioid Use Disorder
description: Percentage of OUD pharmacotherapy events lasting at least 180 days.

denominator.eligiblePopulation: Members with a diagnosis of opioid use disorder and new pharmacotherapy event.

numerator.numeratorDefinition: Pharmacotherapy maintained for at least 180 days.

measureName: Diabetes Screening for People With Schizophrenia or Bipolar Disorder Using Antipsychotic Medications
description: Percentage of members with schizophrenia, schizoaffective disorder or bipolar disorder who received diabetes screening.

denominator.eligiblePopulation: Members with schizophrenia, schizoaffective disorder or bipolar disorder dispensed antipsychotic medication.

measureName: Diabetes Monitoring for People With Diabetes and Schizophrenia
description: Percentage of members with schizophrenia or schizoaffective disorder and diabetes who received LDL-C and HbA1c testing.

denominator.eligiblePopulation: Members with diabetes and schizophrenia or schizoaffective disorder.

numerator.complianceThresholds: Both tests required during measurement year.

measureName: Cardiovascular Monitoring for People With Cardiovascular Disease and Schizophrenia
description: Percentage of members with schizophrenia or schizoaffective disorder and cardiovascular disease who received LDL-C testing.

denominator.eligiblePopulation: Members with schizophrenia or schizoaffective disorder and cardiovascular disease.

measureName: Deprescribing of Benzodiazepines in Older Adults
description: Percentage of members 67 years and older who were dispensed benzodiazepines and achieved a reduction in benzodiazepine dose during the measurement year.

denominator.eligiblePopulation: Members dispensed benzodiazepine medications during measurement year.

numerator.numeratorDefinition: Members achieving ≥20% reduction in Diazepam Milligram Equivalent (DME) dose.

measureName: Use of Opioids at High Dosage
description: Percentage of members receiving prescription opioids at high dosage during the measurement year.

denominator.eligiblePopulation: Members receiving opioid prescriptions for 15 or more days during measurement year.

numerator.numeratorDefinition: Average Morphine Milligram Equivalent (MME) dose >=90 for 15 or more days.

measureName: Use of Opioids From Multiple Providers
description: Percentage of members receiving prescription opioids from multiple prescribers and pharmacies.

denominator.eligiblePopulation: Members receiving opioid prescriptions for 15 or more days during measurement year.

rates.name: Multiple Prescribers and Pharmacies
rates.criteria: 4 or more prescribers and 4 or more pharmacies

measureName: Risk of Continued Opioid Use
description: Percentage of members with a new episode of opioid use that places them at risk for continued opioid use.

continuousEnrollment.enrollmentRule: Continuous enrollment during measurement year and prior period

denominator.eligiblePopulation: Members with a new opioid treatment episode.

rates.name: 15 Days in 30 Days
rates.criteria: At least 15 opioid treatment days in 30-day period

rates.name: 31 Days in 62 Days
rates.criteria: At least 31 opioid treatment days in 62-day period

measureName: Medicare Health Outcomes Survey
description: Measures changes in physical and mental health status of Medicare Advantage members over a two-year period.

continuousEnrollment.enrollmentRule: Continuous Medicare Advantage enrollment throughout survey period

denominator.eligiblePopulation: Medicare Advantage members selected for HOS survey.

numerator.numeratorDefinition: Members whose health status improved or remained as expected between baseline and follow-up surveys.

rates.name: Better Than Expected
rates.description: Physical or mental health improved beyond expected outcome.

measureName: Fall Risk Management
description: Measures discussion and management of fall risk among Medicare members aged 65 years and older.

continuousEnrollment.enrollmentRule: Continuous Medicare enrollment during measurement year

denominator.eligiblePopulation: Members aged 65 and older who had at least one practitioner visit during the previous 12 months.

rates.name: Discussing Fall Risk
rates.description: Member discussed falls, balance problems, or walking difficulties with practitioner.

rates.name: Managing Fall Risk
rates.description: Member received fall prevention recommendations or treatment plan.

exclusions.reason: Member Unable To Participate In Survey

commonErrorsToAvoid: Missing practitioner visit within last 12 months

measureName: Management of Urinary Incontinence in Older Adults
description: Assesses management and treatment discussion of urinary incontinence among Medicare members 65 years and older.

continuousEnrollment.enrollmentRule: Member enrolled in Medicare plan during survey period

denominator.eligiblePopulation: Members 65 years and older who reported urine leakage during the previous 6 months.

rates.definition: Member discussed urine leakage problem with a healthcare provider.
Member discussed treatment options with a healthcare provider.
Member reported urine leakage interfered significantly with daily activities or sleep.

abstractionNotes.title: Survey Measure
abstractionNotes.note: Measure is determined using Medicare HOS survey responses.

exclusions.description: Member did not complete the HOS survey.

commonErrorsToAvoid: Using claims data instead of survey responses

measureName: Physical Activity in Older Adults
description: Assesses provider discussion and counseling regarding physical activity among Medicare members 65 years and older.

continuousEnrollment.enrollmentRule: Member enrolled in Medicare plan during survey year

denominator.eligiblePopulation: Members 65 years and older who completed the HOS survey and had a provider visit within the previous 12 months.

rates.definition: Member discussed exercise or physical activity level with a healthcare provider.
Member received advice to start, increase, or maintain physical activity.

abstractionNotes.title: Survey Measure
abstractionNotes.note: Compliance is based on Medicare HOS survey responses.

exclusions.description: Member did not complete HOS survey.

acceptedEvidenceTypes.notes: Primary source for numerator and denominator calculation.

measureName: Initiation and Engagement of Substance Use Disorder Treatment
description: The percentage of new substance use disorder episodes that result in treatment initiation and engagement.

continuousEnrollment.enrollmentRule: Continuous enrollment 60 days before and 47 days after diagnosis

denominator.eligiblePopulation: Members with a new episode of substance use disorder during the measurement year.

rates.definition: Treatment initiated within 14 days of diagnosis.
Two or more treatment encounters within 34 days after initiation.

measureName: Prenatal and Postpartum Care
description: Measures timeliness of prenatal care and postpartum care following live birth delivery.

continuousEnrollment.enrollmentRule: Continuous enrollment through delivery and postpartum period

denominator.eligiblePopulation: Women with live birth deliveries occurring between October 8 prior year and October 7 measurement year.

rates.definition: Prenatal visit during first trimester, before enrollment, or within 42 days after enrollment.
Postpartum visit between 7 and 84 days after delivery.

measureName: Use of First-Line Psychosocial Care for Children and Adolescents on Antipsychotics
description: Children and adolescents receiving new antipsychotic prescriptions who received psychosocial care before medication initiation.

denominator.eligiblePopulation: Children and adolescents receiving a new antipsychotic prescription.

numerator.numeratorDefinition: Evidence of psychosocial care before or around the initiation of antipsychotic treatment.

exclusions.description: Members already on antipsychotic medication during lookback period.

measureName: Follow-Up Care for Children Prescribed ADHD Medication
description: Percentage of children newly prescribed ADHD medication who received appropriate follow-up care.

continuousEnrollment.enrollmentRule: Continuous enrollment during required measurement period

denominator.eligiblePopulation: Members newly prescribed ADHD medication

initiationPhase.requirement: One follow-up visit with prescribing practitioner within 30 days of first ADHD medication dispensing

continuationMaintenancePhase.requirement: At least two additional follow-up visits within 270 days after initiation phase and medication coverage for at least 210 days

measureName: Metabolic Monitoring for Children and Adolescents on Antipsychotics
description: Percentage of children and adolescents receiving antipsychotics who received metabolic testing.

denominator.eligiblePopulation: Members with two or more antipsychotic medication dispensing events

bloodGlucoseTesting.requirement: At least one blood glucose or HbA1c test during measurement year

cholesterolTesting.requirement: At least one cholesterol or LDL-C test during measurement year

combinedTesting.requirement: Meets both blood glucose and cholesterol testing requirements

measureName: Depression Screening and Follow-Up for Adolescents and Adults
description: Percentage of members screened for depression and receiving appropriate follow-up when screening positive.

denominator.eligiblePopulation: Members 12 years and older

depressionScreening.requirement: Completed depression screening using a standardized instrument

followUpPositiveScreen.requirement: Received follow-up care within 30 days of positive depression screen

measureName: Utilization of the PHQ-9 to Monitor Depression Symptoms for Adolescents and Adults
description: Percentage of members 12 years of age and older with a diagnosis of major depression or dysthymia who had an outpatient encounter with a PHQ-9 score documented during the same assessment period.

denominator.eligiblePopulation: Members age 12 years and older with major depression or dysthymia diagnosis

numerator.numeratorDefinition: Members with a PHQ-9 score documented during the same assessment period as the qualifying outpatient encounter.
numerator.complianceThresholds: At least one PHQ-9 score documented during the assessment period.

acceptedEvidenceTypes.notes: Assessment date and score must be documented.
Must contain depression diagnosis and encounter details.

measureName: Depression Remission or Response for Adolescents and Adults
description: Percentage of members 12 years of age and older with depression and an elevated PHQ-9 score who achieved remission or response within 120-240 days after the initial elevated PHQ-9 score.

denominator.eligiblePopulation: Members with depression diagnosis and elevated PHQ-9 score

followUpPHQ9.definition: Follow-up PHQ-9 completed between 120 and 240 days after initial elevated PHQ-9 score.

depressionRemission.definition: Follow-up PHQ-9 score less than 5 within 120-240 days.

depressionResponse.definition: At least 50% reduction in PHQ-9 score from baseline within 120-240 days.

acceptedEvidenceTypes.notes: Baseline and follow-up scores must be documented.
Must contain encounter dates and PHQ-9 documentation.

measureName: Unhealthy Alcohol Use Screening and Follow-Up
description: Percentage of members 18 years and older screened for unhealthy alcohol use and receiving follow-up care when screening positive.

denominator.eligiblePopulation: Members age 18 years and older

screening.requirement: Completed unhealthy alcohol use screening using a standardized instrument.

followUpCare.requirement: Brief counseling or other follow-up care within 60 days of positive screening.

measureName: Adult Immunization Status
description: Percentage of adults 19 years and older who are up to date on recommended vaccinations.

denominator.eligiblePopulation: Members age 19 years and older

measureName: Prenatal Immunization Status
description: Percentage of deliveries where members received influenza and Tdap vaccinations during pregnancy.

denominator.eligiblePopulation: Members with qualifying deliveries during measurement period

measureName: Prenatal Depression Screening and Follow-Up
description: Percentage of deliveries where members were screened for depression during pregnancy and received follow-up care when screening positive.

denominator.eligiblePopulation: Members with qualifying deliveries

screening.requirement: Depression screening during pregnancy using standardized instrument.

followUp.requirement: Follow-up care within 30 days after positive screening.

measureName: Postpartum Depression Screening and Follow-Up
description: Percentage of deliveries where members were screened for depression during postpartum period and received follow-up care when screening positive.

denominator.eligiblePopulation: Members with qualifying deliveries

followUp.requirement: Follow-up care within 30 days of positive screen.

measureName: Social Need Screening and Intervention
description: Percentage of members screened for food, housing and transportation needs and receiving interventions when screening positive.

denominator.eligiblePopulation: All eligible members during measurement period

foodIntervention.requirement: Intervention within 30 days of positive food insecurity screen.

housingScreening.requirement: Screened for housing instability, homelessness or housing inadequacy.

housingIntervention.requirement: Intervention within 30 days of positive housing screen.

transportationIntervention.requirement: Intervention within 30 days of positive transportation screen.
